purpose: Provisional independent hydrodynamic-simulation generalization test for the TNG-trained V6 EDM model

eagle_status.blocker: EAGLE account activation has not been returned by the data-site administrator
eagle_status.policy: Do not substitute the SQL galaxy catalogue for the unavailable particle-level dark-matter truth

simulation.independence: One observer cube from each of 16 independent initial-condition realizations

sources.orientation_audit: Direct CMD (x,y,z) order ranked first among all 48 cube symmetries by density at massive-galaxy positions; median log10 overdensity 2.126

frozen_selection.observer_choice: candidate closest in log stellar mass to the geometric midpoint of the observer interval; no density-field information used
frozen_selection.threshold_derivation: TNG100-only rank threshold giving exactly the same global count (48296) as the training selection M_B < -15
frozen_selection.simba_photometry_excluded: Native SIMBA SubhaloStellarPhotometrics is documented invalid; the separate photometry index is not consistently joinable to the current corrected SUBFIND rows

cube.resampling: exact separable volume-overlap averaging from the periodic 256^3 density grid to 80^3; preserves mass and box mean

model.normalization: Frozen TNG training normalization; no SIMBA fitting or recalibration

gate_policy.thresholds: Use the already committed V6 field-gate thresholds without inspecting SIMBA truth
gate_policy.hop: Run grid-HOP only if the independent SIMBA field gate passes
gate_policy.interpretation: Passing is evidence of cross-code generalization but does not replace the unavailable EAGLE gate or a forward particle simulation

domain_shift_diagnostics.interpretation: The 25 Mpc/h SIMBA boxes have fewer occupied tracer cells, much narrower radial velocities, and a smoother target than TNG100

result.interpretation: EDM improves PDF and 2pCF but overproduces unresolved high-k variance and fragments voids; this is scale dependent and cannot be repaired by one scalar normalization

decision.reason: The frozen independent field gate failed, so grid-HOP and forward PM/RAMSES are not scientifically authorized
decision.recommended_next_experiment: Keep CV_0 through CV_15 locked as test; use only other simulations/realizations to develop a multi-domain conditional residual model, then rerun this untouched gate
